control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: injury during a breakdown response on P-9504

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on P-9504, M-9504 and PT-9504 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. P-9504 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 3 November 2021 an incident occurred on P-9504, M-9504 and PT-9504 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a breakdown response, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
